settings.heading: A family, a coastline and a lot of seaweed.
settings.lede: Our founder grew up swimming in the Pacific. Decades later, her daughter helped turn that habit into a skin care company.
settings.image_alt: Founder and daughter on a rocky shore
Woven basket of freshly cut sea plants
settings.heading: Skin that borrows from the sea.
settings.text: Sea plants are loaded with minerals, amino acids and moisture-binding sugars. We formulate with them first, then add only the extras a product truly needs.

settings.label: 1920s
settings.title: The swimming club
settings.text: A grandmother and her friends swim in cold water each morning and credit it for their skin.

settings.label: 1980s
settings.title: A healing-arts career
settings.text: Her daughter trains in spa and body therapies and starts to test sea plants in treatments.

settings.title: First formulas on shelves
settings.text: The first seaweed skin care line arrives at a small boutique in Los Angeles.

settings.title: The next generation joins
settings.text: The founder's daughter comes aboard and helps the brand grow beyond one shop.

settings.heading: Good for skin. Kind to the sea.

settings.text: Independent certifications back up both claims on every product.

settings.title: Climate and ocean responsible
settings.text: We offset our carbon footprint and fund a coastal restoration partner.

settings.title: Packaging progress
settings.text: Glass and post-consumer plastic, with a studio take-back program for empties.

settings.title: Formulated to work
settings.text: Every formula is tested for results as well as safety.

settings.title: Honest about ingredients
settings.text: We publish full ingredient lists and explain what each does.

settings.title: Respect for the sea
settings.text: We harvest slowly and give money back to coastal care.

settings.quote: “A seaweed line that actually delivers on moisture.”
“Body care that feels like a day at the beach.”
“A mother-daughter story that holds up on the shelf.”
